title: Half-Light Druqks
prompt: drum n bass meets aphex twin with ambient intros
description: An evolving beatless drone opens into a dark half-time IDM groove led by a rolling sine sub, with a crushed metallic top and a 909 kit. Two peaks driven by euclidean density and bitcrush rise around a hushed valley before the track strips back to its opening haze.
